label: Formaggio di Santo Stefano di Quisquina

about.text: A cylindrical sheep's-milk cheese of about two kilograms from the central Monti Sicani around Santo Stefano Quisquina. The milk is set with lamb rennet, the curd is pressed by hand in baskets, and the cheese is aged about six months.

sources.text: The process, ageing and origin, from this.
